supersedes_for_default: docs/research/vision_caution_integration_protocol_v1.json (the V1 artifact stays loadable by path; its scope is unchanged)
status: host-side advisory, OFF by default; default artifact = vision-caution-v2 (runtime action interface); qualified for logging on the runtime-scene PROXY only; NOT qualified for real cameras or live use

component.interface_v2: VisionCaution(...).assess(frames=(prev, cur) 64x64 grey float in [0,1], proposed_action=(kind, features), frame_ids=(prev_id, cur_id)) -> VisionCautionAdvisory; kind = one of move, inspect, diagnose, approve, repair, verify, stop (name or index 0..6); features = 3 finite values in [-1, 1]
component.action_mapping: identity: one-hot over the 7 PhysicalActionKind values + the 3 raw features, the runtime model's own encoding (train_physical_world_model.make_input without the state); nothing is projected or discarded
component.no_all_clear: There is no 'safe' status. 'no_caution_raised' only means the score is below the calibrated threshold.
component.enable: environment FERRUM_VISION_CAUTION=advisory or VisionCaution(enabled=True); default is disabled
component.output: a JSON record (schema ferrum_vision_caution_advisory_v1) to logs/telemetry only

authority_boundary.authority: advisory diagnostic only; no permit, block, approval, adapter or actuation authority
enforced_by: the artifact metadata authority string (load_artifact rejects any other value) and VisionCautionAdvisory, which refuses a different authority value
no consumer in the guest: nothing under userland/ references the package, its artifacts or its env var (checked by scripts/verify_vision_caution_advisory.py)

the score is never constructed as a PhysicalPrediction and the package has no route to ferrum_routed_command_v1, BridgeCommand, execute_tool, neural_intent_commit or physical_maintenance_demo (checked by the tests and the verifier); accepting the runtime action TYPE as input gives it no route back into the runtime

fail-safe: every doubt (disabled, missing/altered/non-finite artifact, encoder digest mismatch, invalid/obscured/stale/out-of-order frames, an action outside the runtime's InvalidAction rule, timeout, non-finite output, internal error) yields no_confident_caution with a logged reason
authority_boundary.deterministic_gate: unchanged; remains the sole permit authority

vision_caution_head.evaluated_by: docs/research/vision_caution_runtime_proxy_result_v1.json (sealed seed 790, opened once, CPU only; persisted before the open)
vision_caution_head.encoder: facebook/dinov2-small model.safetensors, sha256 recorded in the artifact metadata and re-checked at load

previous_head_v1.scope: unchanged, see integration protocol v1; on the runtime-scene proxy it transfers poorly (zero-shot AUC-PR 0.451, recall 0.152 at its own threshold)

qualification.qualified_for: advisory logging on the runtime-scene proxy: the registered PyBullet integration world (pybullet-direct-box-robot-obstacle-v1) filmed by a fixed overhead 64x64 grey camera, driven through the unmodified PyBulletBackend by runtime PhysicalAction sequences; camera-visible hazards only (obstacle proximity, geofence exit, contact)
not_qualified_for: hazards a camera cannot see (humans, battery, link, e-stop, approval)
other camera placements, resolutions or scenes

evidence.sealed_proxy: vision_caution_runtime_proxy_result_v1.json, seed 790, 4400 decisions in 400 episodes, prevalence 0.255: AUC-PR 0.685 (ROC 0.861), recall 0.464 at realized benign FPR 0.057 (fpr_0.05 threshold, 0.10 budget); beats the pixel probe (AUC-PR 0.323, recall +0.364, episode-cluster CI95 [0.319, 0.407]) and the action-only control (0.295, +0.401, CI95 [0.358, 0.443]); primary PASS
evidence.action_mapping: registered secondary S1 PASS: the identity runtime-action head beats the lossy 5-impulse projection head, recall +0.034 (CI95 [0.013, 0.054]), AUC-PR 0.685 vs 0.679; the projection loses little ranking but costs recall at the frozen threshold
evidence.limits_seen: the true-geometry state reference reaches AUC-PR 0.858 (recall 0.647 at FPR 0.045), so the camera is a weaker, redundant view of what the runtime's state estimate already supports; recall is 0.55 when the proposed action is a Move but 0.20-0.29 for non-motion kinds, whose positives come from later, unseen actions or from already being outside the fence
evidence.real_footage_other_domain: vision_world_model_ccd_result_v1.json (dashcam crash anticipation) tests the approach on real video in another domain; it does not qualify this head

promotion_conditions: OPEN: a sealed, single-open evaluation on real footage of a real deployment camera and scene, with independent labels (labels must not come from the frames the advisory sees), passing pre-registered gates including a held false-alarm budget calibrated on real benign footage with the half-budget margin. FerrumOS has no real robot or camera yet; the runtime-scene proxy does not satisfy this condition.
MET on the proxy: an explicit mapping from the runtime action space to the head's action input, re-evaluated under that mapping (identity mapping, S1 above).
OPEN: a written authority-boundary review before any consumer inside userland/ is added; a vision score must never be passed as a PhysicalPrediction.
Until all are met the component stays off by default and advisory-only.

verification.verifier_replay: python scripts/verify_vision_caution_advisory.py --replay (re-renders selection seeds 1 and 201 and re-derives both 5% thresholds)
